title: DIC - Strategic Sourcing
location: Kamaraj Road, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu , India
jobDescription:
Purpose of the Role:

To work closely with key stakeholders in member organizations and in corporate functions to develop effective cost reduction strategies and implementation plans with the goal of achieving significant initial cost reductions, supplanted with year-over-year productivity improvements of 5% in the total cost of goods and services procured while maintaining or improving product quality and vendor service levels

Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

  • Oversee the development and execution of strategies through the strategic sourcing process for specific Category Group of spend areas

  • Serve as primary champion and process leader for the strategic sourcing process for each of the spend areas

  • Measure and Track forecasted vs actual savings for the Category Group of commodities and is responsible for communicating performance against these measures and their potential budgetary impact

  • Responsible for leading strategic sourcing efforts in specific commodity areas as necessary/appropriate.

  • Work actively with key stakeholders such as Engineering and Marketing to ensure purchasing is actively engaged in core business processes

  • Set priorities and performance goals for Core or Lead Buyers, guide strategy development for major commodities, oversee the development of annual strategic sourcing plans which specify how savings goals will be achieved

  • "Oversee the process to select and manage suppliers"

  • Establish and maintain contractual and business relationships with the senior management of key suppliers

  • Achieve small and disadvantaged business sourcing content objectives

  • Work together with senior stakeholders in the business units to ensure savings are built into budgets and the annual operating plan

  • Work with each Core or Lead Buyers to ensure sourcing strategies are implemented and TCO reductions are secured according to forecasts

  • Responsible for breaking down organizational barriers and communicating overall sourcing trends/results for his/her commodities to the Group CPO and business unit purchasing leadership

  • Develop, champion, and ensure implementation of ideas that will optimize LMW’s total cost of ownership for spend categories

  • Remain current with market trends through relationships with Sourcing Managers, suppliers and market experts, and ensure LMW has a process to gain access/familiarity with emerging supplier capabilities

  • Maintain a working knowledge of applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations as well as any internal policies (e.g. code of ethics) or procedures to ensure that the behavior exhibited by the organization is honest, ethical and professional

  • Identify/define sourcing best-practices both within and external to LMW and ensure that those best practices are widely adopted by LMW’s business groups

  • Supervise the Core or Lead Buyers, communicate team progress with the Head - Strategic SCM and senior business unit leadership and ensure clear alignment between team actions and business unit interests

  • Develop performance objectives and conduct annual reviews with all associated Core or Lead Buyers

  • Participate in career planning and development for each Sourcing Manager and assume a mentoring relationship with high-potential sourcing professionals

  • Improve overall sourcing morale by communicating savings opportunities and successes throughout the company for strategic sourcing commodities and will actively champion the elevation of purchasing as a valued and career enhancing experience

title: Team Member - Field Sales - North Zone
location: Bhikaji Cama Palace, New Delhi, Delhi , India
jobDescription:
Purpose of the role:
  • Responsible for conversion of field enquiry as per funnel management. Ensure effectiveness of visits and calls.
  • Understand customer requirements, sell right Products to the customers.
  • To accomplish the targeted Sales for my allocated area.
  • To accomplish the profitability through revenue generation from high value machines & tooled up machines.

Roles & Responsibilities:
  • Ensure execution of on-field enquiry conversion tasks assigned by funnel manager
  • Responsible for executing the field enquiries by direct interaction with customers for prosecuting existing enquiries in the sales funnel.
  • Visit customers for executing sales tasks as per the schedule given by funnel manager.
  • Required to participate in short daily WIP meetings with Funnel Managers for reviewing tasks executed during the day and discussing tasks scheduled for the next day.

  • Able to effectively communicate all the elements of the market offers and address the customer objections w.r.t the same.
  • Achieve Sales revenues from the high value machines / tooled up machines as per the target
  • Participate in exhibitions to promote our products to generate enquires and convert Sales orders.
  • Maintains relationships with clients by providing support, information, and guidance; researching and recommending new opportunities; recommending profit and service improvements.

Desired Candidates Profile:

  • Candidates from Machine Tool Industry / Capital Goods Industry with experience in Machine (CNC/VMC/HMC) sales and business development is preferred
  • Candidate having qualification of Bachelor / Diploma in Engineering is preferred
  • Candidate having very good local language is preferred
  • Candidate having very good attitude and communication is preferred

title: Team Lead - Infra & Network
jobDescription:
Server Administration

·Administer and maintain Windows Server and Linux Server environments.

·Perform installation, configuration, patch management, upgrades, and health monitoring.

·Troubleshoot complex server-related incidents and perform root cause analysis.

·Manage Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy (GPO), Certificate Services, and authentication services.

·Ensure server security hardening and compliance with organizational standards.

Virtualization & Hyper-Converged Infrastructure

·Administer Microsoft Hyper-V clusters.

·Manage Nutanix HCI infrastructure, including Prism Central and Prism Element.

·Perform VM provisioning, migration, capacity planning, and performance tuning.

·Ensure high availability and business continuity of virtual infrastructure.

Storage Administration

·Manage SAN and NAS storage infrastructure.

·Configure storage provisioning, zoning, LUN mapping, snapshots, and replication.

·Monitor storage capacity and optimize storage performance.

·Coordinate firmware upgrades and preventive maintenance.

Backup & Disaster Recovery

·Administer Commvault Backup infrastructure.

·Monitor backup jobs and restore operations.

·Conduct backup validation and disaster recovery testing.

·Ensure backup compliance and recovery objectives are met.

Microsoft 365 Administration

·Administer Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Azure AD.

·Manage user provisioning, licensing, security policies, Conditional Access, and MFA.

·Troubleshoot Microsoft 365-related issues.

Infrastructure Monitoring & Performance

·Monitor enterprise infrastructure health and availability.

·Perform preventive maintenance and infrastructure optimization.

·Conduct performance analysis and capacity planning.

·Ensure production uptime and SLA compliance.

Incident & Problem Management

·Provide L3 support for critical production incidents.

·Lead technical troubleshooting during major incidents.

·Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and recommend preventive actions.

·Coordinate with OEMs and technology partners for issue resolution.

Project Implementation

·Participate in infrastructure modernization projects.

·Support server migration, virtualization, storage upgrades, and cloud integration.

·Prepare implementation plans and technical documentation.

·Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external vendors.

Documentation & Compliance

·Maintain infrastructure documentation, SOPs, architecture diagrams, and asset inventory.

·Ensure compliance with cybersecurity policies, backup policies, and audit requirements.

·Support internal and external IT audits.

Technical Skills Required

Operating Systems

·Microsoft Windows Server (2016/2019/2022)

·Linux (Oracle Linux, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Ubuntu)

Virtualization

·Microsoft Hyper-V

·Nutanix HCI (Prism Central / Prism Element)

Storage

·SAN Storage

·NAS Storage

·Storage provisioning and performance management

Backup

·Commvault Backup & Recovery

·Disaster Recovery Planning and Testing

Receive and Process request for fund loading into IB cash card through Indian Bank

Identify relevant products introduced by banks and if approved, implement the same at LMW;

Receive and Reconcile all credit card payments with credit card statement and take action for noted variances;

Arrange Indian / Other Bank's Cash Card with DIC approval to employees and reconcile them periodically with receipt of bills;

Process & Arrange Gratuity settlement from Insurance companies;

Co-ordinate & Arrange Employee's on-board into Group Mediclaim Policy and Applicable Refund;

Co-ordinate with liasion office & Receive Expense / BRS statement periodically;

Receive GST Invoices from Banks / Insurance Companies periodically;

Receive / download bank related statements periodically ;

Receive and Respond the request [or] complaints raised by banks / Insurance companies / Other stakeholders dealing with Treasury sub function;

Co-ordinate and Arrange Forex Currency to meet Business Foreign Travel as per policy with FIC approval;

Collect Quote and negotiate with vendors like forex / service providers like banks about product pricing and obtain approving authorities approval;

Co-ordinate the treasury related "inter" and "intra" functional activities;

Monitor Employee's Running Advances and It's Recovery & Reconcile with GL periodically;

Verify and Process Employee full and final settlement including VRS;

Receive & Update in system, the Payroll related deductions handled in Treasury;

Verify & Disburse Salary, Wages, Bonus, Gratuity and other employee related payments with DIC approval;

Verify & Disburse promptly the recovered amount of housing loan, society loan, insurance etc., that are payable to various institutions ;

Initiate action for record disposal with DIC / FIC approval.

Maintain such other records and confidential information safely and submit to the authorised person on demand;

Receive / Account [or] Ensure accounting of income, bills, vouchers, claims & reimbursements with appropriate approval / policy & Monitor pending compliants, if any;

Verify and Release consultancy payments as per agreements / invoices every month

Apply Receipts and Reconcile periodically all liaison office advances / Travel advances / Salary advances etc.,

Verify and Settle claims and reimbursements as per policy / accorded approval;

Verify and Post Staff Tax Investment details periodically

Perform / Ensure reconciliation of all Bank Accounts [including liasion office]; Investment Account and Other applicable GL codes;
